rachel: FYI AE sent a request: Bluefjord wants to run a 3-week POC using a customer-finetuned `bluefjord-13b-ft-v2` model. Needs Private deploy in ap-southeast-1, customer KMS, and embeddings + chat APIs. Main asks: catalog onboarding path, compatibility with our serving runtime, and any enterprise blockers for them to sign the SOW.

kofi: Quick check 11 are they supplying HF/gguf artifact or a packaged docker image? Any custom tokenizer?

rachel: They uploaded `bluefjord-13b-ft-v2.gguf` and `tokenizer.json` plus a short eval set. Tokenizer appears to be custom, and they noted they used a modified eos token. Also they requested deterministic gen and strict per-request audit logs for compliance.

ben: Runtime notes: gguf is ok. Custom eos token is a red flag; we need to validate special token alignment (pad/bos/eos) with our request pipeline. If mismatch, artifacts may generate extra special tokens, breaking prompts. We can shim but prefer merged tokenizer from customer.

ivy: Security 11 they flagged the audit log requirement. We can provide audit metadata (request id, model id, token counts) but logging raw inputs needs explicit consent and retention controls. Also ap-southeast-1 private deploy is doable but requires a regional infra request and data residency confirmation. KMS: we require a key ARN with a policy granting RedwoodDeployRole kms:Decrypt,kms:GenerateDataKey.

infra-bot: [artifact-scan] bluefjord-13b-ft-v2.gguf scanned: tokenizer.json present, vocab size 51k, special token <|eos|> mapped to id 2 (non-standard), adapter files: none detected, file load check OK. License check passed.

kofi: Perf: 13B at P95<200ms for short prompts at 30 rps is tough in ap-southeast-1 depending on GPU type. Options: (A) Dedicated pinned pool with warm replicas (B) quantized int8 single-gpu with aggressive batching (C) hybrid: embeddings served on 6-7B. Also need to confirm whether they accept small latency SLO relaxations during cold starts.

ben: For deterministic responses set temperature=0 and disable sampling. Also confirm they don't rely on nucleus sampling. We'll add a note that fallback variants will change outputs.

rachel: They asked if we can provide an automatic fallback to a distilled 7B in event of capacity shortfall. They expect identical prompts to be re-routed.

ben: We can implement policy-based fallback routing to `bluefjord-7b-distill` but must warn about semantic drift. QA gating needed.

ivy: Action items from security side: 1) Confirm KMS ARN and key policy from customer. 2) Confirm allowed audit log fields and retention TTL. 3) Regional compliance ok for ap-southeast-1? Customer requires logs to remain in-region.

rachel: Proposed minimal deploy config to share with customer:
```
model: bluefjord-13b-ft-v2
format: gguf
precision: int8
deploy_mode: private
region: ap-southeast-1
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 5
batching: {max_tokens: 1024, dynamic_window_ms: 10}
audit_mode: metadata-only
fallback_policy: route_to_bluefjord_7b_on_capacity
```

infra-bot: [ticket] Created SW-4672 "Bluefjord POC 1 onboard & token-check" assigned to ben,kofi,ivy. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/SW-4672

kofi: I'll run tokenizer compatibility check and a small prompt-regression eval against their set. If eos mapping differs we'll ask them to regenerate or approve a shim.

ben: I'll size infra and provide cost delta for int8 vs fp16 and provide recommeded GPU types in ap-southeast-1. Also will include warmup plan for KV cache to meet latency SLO.

ivy: I'll draft the security checklist for the customer to sign (KMS ARN, audit fields, retention TTL, EU/region notes if any) and confirm suspicions about raw input logging.

rachel: Great. I'll loop in AE and send the proposed plan + config + SOW draft. Please post quick blockers here if any come up. :shipit:

ben: One more note 11 if they request HSM-backed keys escalate to security; that takes extra lead time.

kofi: Running token check now, will attach mismatch snippet in Jira ticket.

ivy: Will prepare a short redlined SOW section for audit logs and fallback behavior.

rachel: Thanks all. Will keep thread updated. :eyes:
